name: Weapon Finesse
flavor: You are incredibly deft with a blade
benefits: This is a combat feat that scales with your Base Attack Bonus

scaleBenefits.benefit: You may use your Dexterity Modifier instead of your Strength modifier for calculating your melee attack bonus.
You may use your Dexterity modifier in place of your Strength modifier for calculating your melee damage.
You may use your Dexterity modifier in place of your Strength modifier when attempting a combat maneuver.
Once per turn, when an opponent is struck, you may take an attack of opportunity on that opponent.
